verdicts: Fair test: the decreasing reward acts: with it the distance-rewarded learner builds more nodes (FLAT_GU minus FLAT_G nodes, range above 0)
Decreasing rewards for consistently used nodes rescue the distance reward on generalization: FLAT_GU minus FLAT_G, above 0
They also rescue its memory of old problems: FLAT_GU minus FLAT_G, all problems at the end, above 0
Distance + decreasing reward beats the plain flat learner on generalization: FLAT_GU minus FLAT, above 0
The decreasing reward alone helps the flat learner generalize: FLAT_U minus FLAT, above 0
The decreasing reward alone helps later problems: FLAT_U minus FLAT, above 0
Distance + decreasing reward generalizes better than the plain network: FLAT_GU minus DENSE, above 0
Vertical: FLAT_GU later minus earlier bits, above 0
